name: pace-qa-prod-modules
description: Production dashboard module navigation and Control Tower reports automation (Playwright POM)

scripts.clean:reports: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$paths = 'allure-report','allure-results','playwright-report','test-results'; foreach ($path in $paths) { if (Test-Path $path) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $path } }"
scripts.test:dev3:all:full: cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 playwright test --project=prod-modules-email --workers=4 && cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 playwright test --project=control-tower-reports-email --workers=1
scripts.test:dev3:all:headed: cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 playwright test --project=prod-modules-email --headed --workers=4 && cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 playwright test --project=control-tower-reports-email --headed --workers=1
scripts.test:local:prod: cross-env PACE_ENV=prod node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && npm run test:prod:all
scripts.test:local:dev3: cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && npm run test:dev3:all:full
scripts.test:local:prod:headed: cross-env PACE_ENV=prod node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && npm run test:prod:all:headed
scripts.test:local:dev3:headed: cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && npm run test:dev3:all:headed
scripts.test:both:all: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n prod,dev3 "npm run test:all" "npm run test:dev3:all"
scripts.test:both:all:headed: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n prod,dev3 "npm run test:all:headed" "npm run test:dev3:all:headed"
scripts.test:both:prod-first: npm run test:local:prod && npm run test:local:dev3
scripts.test:both:prod-first:headed: npm run test:local:prod:headed && npm run test:local:dev3:headed
scripts.test:ci: cross-env PACE_ENV=prod node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=prod PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT=report-prod-modules.json playwright test --project=prod-modules-email --workers=4 && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=prod PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT=report-control-tower.json PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS=1 CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=180000 CASE_ATTEMPT_MS=90000 SLOW_CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=300000 SLOW_CASE_ATTEMPT_MS=150000 DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS=45000 playwright test --project=control-tower-reports-email tests/Control-tower-reports/reports --workers=1
scripts.test:ci:prod-modules: cross-env PACE_ENV=prod node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=prod playwright test --project=prod-modules-email --workers=4
scripts.test:ci:control-tower: cross-env PACE_ENV=prod node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=prod PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS=1 CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=180000 CASE_ATTEMPT_MS=90000 SLOW_CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=300000 SLOW_CASE_ATTEMPT_MS=150000 DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS=45000 playwright test --project=control-tower-reports-email tests/Control-tower-reports/reports --workers=1
scripts.test:ci:fast: cross-env PACE_ENV=prod node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=prod PACE_FAST=true playwright test --project=prod-modules-email --workers=4
scripts.test:ci:dev3: cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=dev3 PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT=report-dev3-modules.json playwright test --project=prod-modules-email --workers=4 && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=dev3 PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT=report-dev3-control-tower.json PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS=1 CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=180000 CASE_ATTEMPT_MS=90000 SLOW_CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=300000 SLOW_CASE_ATTEMPT_MS=150000 DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS=45000 playwright test --project=control-tower-reports-email --workers=1
scripts.test:ci:dev3:prod-modules: cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=dev3 playwright test --project=prod-modules-email --workers=4
scripts.test:ci:dev3:control-tower: cross-env PACE_ENV=dev3 node scripts/validate-ci-env.js && cross-env CI=true PACE_ENV=dev3 PLAYWRIGHT_WORKERS=1 CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=180000 CASE_ATTEMPT_MS=90000 SLOW_CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=300000 SLOW_CASE_ATTEMPT_MS=150000 DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS=45000 playwright test --project=control-tower-reports-email --workers=1
scripts.ci:install: npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
